info.description:
API for Available - Room Booking Application for Students
This API provides endpoints for managing room bookings, user accounts, and related resources.
info.title: Available API

get.description: Get a paginated list of all user accounts

post.description: Authenticate user and receive access token

get.description: Get account details for a specific student
Get a paginated list of all bookings

post.description: Update the status of a booking

get.description: Get all bookings for a specific account
Get a list of all custom field definitions

put.description: Create or update a custom field value for a room (admin only)

post.description: Create a new custom field definition (admin only)

get.description: Get all custom field values for a specific room
get.summary: Get custom field values for a room

get.description: Get a paginated list of all rooms with their current status
Get detailed information about a specific room including custom fields
Get all bookings for a specific room on a specific date
